cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lift them both. You only have to read how much bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pick the scales yourself. We can have the number before you go.
